items.title: Told today that Dallas has held some early stage talks with Dereck Lively II on a possible contract extension.
items.author: Marc Stein
items.body_excerpt:
Told today that Dallas has held some early stage talks with Dereck Lively II on a possible contract extension.

Lively, 22, is eligible for a new deal until Opening Night Eve but played in just seven games in 2025-26 before foot surgery.
